thread:
alex: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp failing intermittently on embed -> rerank flow. Repro attached, happens during bulk-batching.

maria: repro steps?

alex: steps: 1) call sampleapp /api/ingest -> it batches 100 docs with embed.helpers.batchByTokenWindow 2) call /api/rerank with the returned vectors 3) rerank sometimes returns wrong number of scores (or 400)

alex: minimal curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input":["doc1","doc2","doc3"]}'
```

alex: expected: embeddings -> [[...128], [...128], [...128]] (3 vectors of dim 128)
actual (snippet):
```json
{"embeddings":[[...128],[...127]]}
```
(see: second vector trimmed to 127)

samir: that trimming rings a bell — batch helper tries to compact by token window and then reserializes. Could be a buffer copy bug that drops the last float when batch size == boundary. Seen similar in go batching lib.

julie: also seeing reports where rerank returns array of scores shorter than inputs, e.g. scores length 2 for 3 candidates. Usually downstream code assumes 1:1 and NPEs.

cheng: I dug into logs — there are two correlated signals: a) SDK auth refresh triggered a retry loop around the same time (some 401 -> refresh -> retry) b) the embed helper emits a "batch_sent" entry with byte_length that doesn't match payload length. Hypothesis: auth retry path resends an already-serialized buffer while the last vector was still being appended, causing a race and truncated payload.

maria: that's nasty. Can we reproduce locally?

alex: yes, repro script below (node):
```js
// gist: push many small docs quickly, flip auth token expiry to short time
await sampleapp.ingestMany(200, {batchWindowMs: 10, tokenTtlSec: 2});
```
It reliably triggers after ~3 runs.

samir: quick mitigation: validate vector dims before sending rerank. If mismatch, pad with zeros or reject early. But we should prefer fixing race.

cheng: simple patch idea: make embed.helpers.batchByTokenWindow write immutable copy before scheduling send. That avoids concurrent mutation. Also add a debug flag to log per-batch checksums for a short window.

julie: we should also harden rerank response validation: if scores.length != candidates.length -> return 502 and a helpful error to callers instead of proceeding. Add a unit test to sampleapp to catch this.

docs-bot: FYI — onboarding test suite failure count +3 last 24h (https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/sampleapp)

alex: I'll open a tiny PR with two commits: 1) copy-on-send in batch helper + checksum logging, 2) rerank response validation + test. PR #5843.

maria: thanks. Can you also add a small section in the onboarding README: "vector dim sanity" with a short why/how to detect? New users keep hitting this.

alex: will do. Example helper snippet I'll add to docs:
```py
def pad_or_trim(vec, dim):
    if len(vec) < dim:
        return vec + [0.0] * (dim - len(vec))
    return vec[:dim]
```

samir: for SDK parity, add same pad/trim utility in go/node/rust so sample apps behave identical.

cheng: QA checklist for this issue: 1) reproduce with tokenTtlSec=2 2) run with checksum logging for 5 mins 3) assert no truncated vectors 4) assert rerank throws clear error on mismatch

julie: I'll add the rerank validation test to e2e test matrix.

alex: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/sampleapp/pulls/5843 (wip). Tagging @docs and @eng-ml for visibility :eyes:

maria: great. once PR merged, let's run a 12h overnight ingest to be sure.

alex: will do and post back results tomorrow. Thanks all :rocket:
